visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit bathroom, a young man with styled brown hair and a gray Hurley t-shirt stands before a shelf of toiletries and a white toilet. He holds a large, rectangular gray-blue towel sealed in a transparent plastic bag with the brand name TICKET printed on it. He gestures toward the label with his right hand while talking enthusiastically to the camera. (2) The man tears open the plastic packaging and removes a textured, waffle-weave light blue towel. He unfolds it, revealing its considerable size—nearly as tall as his own height. He holds it up to the camera, showcasing the soft fabric and a small rectangular logo patch on one corner. (3) The scene shifts to a white porcelain sink filled with clear water. The man plunges the folded blue towel into the sink. His hands press the fabric down, and the water level visibly drops rapidly as the towel absorbs the liquid. The background remains the bathroom interior with various hygiene products visible on shelves. (4) He lifts the now heavy, saturated towel from the sink, which is now almost entirely dry. He points at the bottom of the sink to demonstrate the effective absorption. He continues to speak with high energy, looking directly into the lens, emphasizing the quality and practicality of the towel for daily use.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male narrator with a clear, projected voice begins speaking immediately in Traditional Chinese. His pitch is moderately high, and his delivery is fast and enthusiastic. Underneath, a rhythmic, electronic-pop BGM plays at roughly 124 BPM with a steady bass beat and bright synth textures. (2) The narrator's speech continues without significant pauses, maintaining a persuasive and animated tone. A distinct, high-frequency rustling sound of plastic film being crinkled and torn is clearly audible for several seconds as the background music maintains a consistent volume and upbeat feel. (3) The acoustic environment shifts as the sound of splashing water and rhythmic, soft thudding of wet fabric hitting a porcelain surface becomes prominent. The narrator’s voice becomes even more excited, exhibiting higher pitch variability as he reacts to the visual absorption test. The BGM continues its steady, energetic loop. (4) The splashing sounds subside, replaced by continuous high-energy narration as the speaker summarizes the benefits of the towel. His tone remains friendly and authoritative, using rising intonations to emphasize the product's value. The audio track concludes with the narrator's final enthusiastic sentence overlapping the steady electronic beat.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote and showcase the high absorption capabilities and large size of a TICKET-branded towel through a direct demonstration in a bathroom setting, aimed at generating consumer interest.
